name: Canada Place

Lower dock arcade depth, interiors, horns, gardens, signage and animated sail lighting remain simplified or omitted. Far retains the corrected silhouette. Cityscape and Full 3D world not tested yet, integration is checked separately; independent re-review pending.

name: Marine Building
notes: Published height 97.8 m, mapped finial 98 m. Setback heights mapped from OSM. Northeastern podium is estimated at 22 m except the mapped 8 m porch; facade grid, ribs, portal and ornament are photo approximations. Separate window rows/bays survive far LOD. Reliefs suggest scallops, waves and a sailing ship, rather than reproducing the detailed historical sculptures. No interior, signage, textures or scanned geometry. No Tesla hardware measurements. Review b5a: strengthened grouped pale terra-cotta piers, green spandrels, stepped pendant crown frames and carved pale/green portal voussoirs in both LODs. Near piers replace the original wall and project 0.22 m with closed returns; far retains separate flush window quads in cut wall openings, eliminating buried reveals without losing rows/bays. Existing nine OSM ownership ways and rigid grade retained; no provider overlap was established by obscured app views. Ornamental proportions and marine motifs remain photo-based abstractions. Current exported costs: near 20,055 triangles / 7 draws / 881,776 bytes; far 7,206 triangles / 7 draws / 260,156 bytes. Scoped geometry QA and depth checks pass with zero material cycles; fresh both-mode app recapture and independent re-review remain with the lead.

name: Vancouver Public Library (Library Square)
notes: Review b8a finding 1: far now retains all seven core rows and the exact near office-floor elevations. Savings come from continuous flat jamb skins, single inter-floor gap panels, fewer horizontal bay subdivisions, omitted reveals and planting tops instead of concealed thin-box faces. Finding 2: spatially varied lighting avoids aligned luminous rows across neighbouring tower parts. Far glow panes occupy only the middle of a coarse bay, with ordinary glass on each side and dark opaque gaps at every actual floor. No floors are combined vertically. The ellipse, gallery orders, spiral fins, canopy and mapped ownership are retained. near 50,650 triangles / 6 draws / 2153.8 KiB; far 10,444 triangles / 6 draws / 468.1 KiB. name: Gastown Steam Clock
notes: Sourced: about 5 m total height (the model's whistle tip is 5.00 m) and the layout of four dials, a pagoda roof and five whistles. Estimated from photographs: every stage height and width (plinth 0.92 m, shaft 0.58 m, cabinet 0.84 m, cornice 1.0 m), the whistle diameters, the arched works windows (the real ones show the weights and a bell behind glass), the dial size, and the bollard ring. The plaque and vent are on one side only, assigned to the south-south-east face. Not modelled: the steam plume, the neighbouring lamp post and flower baskets, the plaque's lettering, the gilt blossoms' colours and the Roman numerals' shapes (ticks stand in). The brick pad is a stylised 3 m patch of the mapped brick corner, 8 cm proud. Far drops the numerals, hands, grille, plaque, blossoms and chains but keeps the stages, arched windows, dials and all five whistles. The site is flat local grade.
